text: Before you reach a property settlement agreement, there are three things to consider. Here's a quick guide from Mobbs, Marr Legal. First, know what's in your property pool. Ask for source documents, not verbal assurances, and remember superannuation is treated as property too. Second, check the outcome is fair and workable. A split that appears equal is not automatically fair. Third, formalise it properly, through consent orders or a Binding Financial Agreement, and on time. An informal arrangement won't give you the finality you expect. If you're considering a property settlement, our team can help. Speak with Mobbs, Marr Legal.
